basic_info.description: Live your best life in this studio junior 1 bed condo with 1 full bathroom at ONE Mission Bay, a luxury, resort-like building just minutes from the Chase Center, Oracle Park, ATWater Tavern, Dumpling Time, beautiful running and biking paths. Built in 2017/2018, the unit is appointed in high-end curated finishes, such as Porcelanosa tile, Vdara quartz, & espresso hardwood floors. This residence features a clean, natural sophistication focused on the beauty of fine materials. That emphasis on quality characterizes One Mission Bay, which has plush amenities such as a heated outdoor pool & spa w/ cabanas, a fitness center w/ dry sauna, private meeting rooms, a game room, dog wash, fire pits and more. Chef-grade kitchen w/ custom cabinets and Gaggenau suite of stainless appliances and refrigerator. The Bedroom is separated with a privacy wall and large closet. Walk to the beloved Gus's Community Market, events at the Chase Center & Oracle Park, or dozens of restaurants and bars.
